source_resolution.reason: The original monograph full text is unrecovered after the initial failure and five recovery retries. The two imported results (the algebra-compatibility of the Ext/convolution identification and the associativity proof) are supplied by the complete local reconstructions in thm-verdier-duality-identification-intertwines-yoneda-product-and-convolution and lem-complex-oriented-diagonal-thom-class-realizes-the-six-functor-exchange-on-supports, conditional only on the in-run six-functor/constructible suppliers, so the CG source dependency is dropped. No missing original text is treated as evidence.
source_resolution.search_summary: Autonomous web searches for the exact theorem and for an open copy of the monograph located the publisher's paywalled landing page, the d-nb.info front-matter/table-of-contents PDF (confirming the section and theorem locations), Google Books metadata, unrelated papers citing [CG97], and a Scribd upload that is not an authoritative full text. No author-hosted or otherwise accessible complete copy was found.

alternatives.argument: The convolution product is defined by the refined oriented middle-diagonal operation of the Thom/exchange lemma with proper pushforward as the dualizing trace, and the equivariant Borel-Moore groups are well defined by the stable Borel approximation comparison; Ginzburg SS2 supplies the supported construction and Varshavsky SS1.1 the composition, so no CG input is used.

The typed triple-diagram mate comparison, the supported orientation check identifying the exceptional exchange with the complex Thom class, and the Beck-Chevalley composed-unit identity close the product square locally; the algebra-structure compatibility is thus proved rather than imported from CG Theorem 8.6.7.
